subject: death cult ritual
fact: A Myconid dances and sings of the Great Seeder’s wedding to the Great Body, inviting all Myconids to join in joy, while emitting a chaotic, evil melody identical to that heard from Zuggtmoy’s dream.
source_quote: Welcome, have you come to see the all that Myconids that will be? They are all necessary for Phylo’s great plan and the Greet Seeder who is coming! ... It has no rhythm, no beauty, it revels in a symphony of chaos and evil. It hurts. ... Yrberop ... is singing about some Great Seeder, and her “wedding” to the Great Body and how every Myconid is invited bringing joy to all in the world below and above.

subject: Drow intelligence gathering
fact: Daz gathers intelligence on the fungal threat, noting the transformation of Xinaya and the emergence of the Great Seeder as a new demonic force in the Underdark.
source_quote: My name is Xinaya, and I was sent to find you. Ilvara thought you would come here. ... You must warn the other Drow of the presence of the Demon Queen of the Fungi in the Underdark.

subject: explorer’s warning
fact: Rasharoo, a Myconid explorer, warns that the Grove is deteriorating and that Myconids are naturally nomadic, contrary to the cultivated norm, and fears the Overbrite plan.
source_quote: Every time I come back, it changes, and its changes are not for the best. ... The myconid is a nomad. ... That would be a terrible idea. Myconids thrive in the dark. Why would we go into the light of the Overbrite?

subject: explosion-based fungal regeneration
fact: Corpse explosions cure the fungal abomination, suggesting the Great Seeder’s power thrives on destruction and decay.
source_quote: Just then, a corpse explodes, and the bloody parts somehow cure the abomination.

subject: Fungal Abomination
fact: The fungal abomination gurgled and spoke in mind and voice, inviting travelers to the wedding rehearsal of the Great Seeder and the Great Body.
source_quote: Are you here for the wedding rehearsal? Friends of the bride or her intended? No matter! Let the love of the Great Seeder embrace you as you become one with her chosen, the Great Body!

subject: fungal abomination attack
fact: A larval fungal aberration, possibly a corrupted Myconid, declares itself servant of the Great Seeder and initiates a wedding ritual, triggering explosions, acid, and spore clouds that transform victims into new servants.
source_quote: Welcome, travelers. Are you here for the wedding rehearsal? ... Let the love of the Great Seeder embrace you as you become one with her chosen, the Great Body! ... And then boom, as the fire mote flies from Daz’s hand and explodes in a conflagration of fire. And then another corpse explodes, drenching us all in acid. ... A spore cloud covers us all.

subject: Fungal wedding
fact: A wedding ceremony has taken place between Araumycos and Zuggtmoy, marked by spore clouds, exploding corpses, Drow spore servants, and a fungal choir; the party arrives as potential guests or prey.
source_quote: There’s a wedding! I guess we arrived at the wedding! ... The Lady will be wed! ... Her joyous spores will spread! ... Joined together, heart to heart, Becoming one ’til death do part!

subject: fungal wedding
fact: A wedding is occurring between the myconid collective and Zuggtmoy, marked by luminescent lichen, chaotic growths, and spreading joyous spores.
source_quote: There’s a wedding! I guess we arrived at the wedding!

subject: Grygum

source_quote: Grygum awkwardly asks, “So wait, you are mushrooms, like the food, and you eat other mushrooms?”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum concluded that Myconids are herbivores with specific preferences and cooking styles, like other creatures.
source_quote: Myconid’s are herbivores. Much like other creatures, we have particular preferences and cooking styles and ways of meeting, producing, and consuming the food that reflect the wide variety of tastes and pellets of the individual myconids.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum concluded that Myconids are not just mushrooms but a sentient species with unique preferences and cooking styles.
source_quote: We are a special kind of mushroom, or more precisely, we are not mushrooms because we are a sentient species.

subject: myconid nomadism debate

source_quote: The myconid is a nomad. ... No, Rasharoo is one of our kind who is always exploring. That is why they are exploring. Myconids stay in one place and cultivate their gardens.

subject: Myconid Reorganization
fact: A radical shift in Myconid societal structure, initiated by Phylo and endorsed by the Great Seeder, replacing the single communal meld with layered, decentralized internal melds between leaders and their specialized groups.
source_quote: Phylo convinced some of the circle leaders that the Great Seeder told them of another way.

subject: myconid union
fact: Araumycos and Zuggtmoy! Joined together, heart to heart, Becoming one ’til death do part!
source_quote: Araumycos and Zuggtmoy! Joined together, heart to heart, Becoming one ’til death do part!

subject: Phylo’s Reorganization
fact: Phylo has restructured Myconid society by replacing the Great Circle with nested melds: one for leaders, one for masters, and isolated task groups. This has fractured communal unity, sparked civil division, and enabled the rise of the Circle of Welcome death cult.

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo claimed Myconids are messages for a greater Myconid that connects the tunnels and caves.
source_quote: I think the caves and tunnels are really another Myconid that connects everything. And that we are messages for that myconid.

subject: Rasharoo

source_quote: That would be a terrible idea. Myconids thrive in the dark. Why would we go into the light of the Overbrite?

subject: The Battle at the Garden of Welcome

subject: The Infection of Xinaya’s Squad
fact: Xinaya’s Drow squad was infected after entering the Circle of Welcome, succumbing to fungal possession and madness; their bodies became hosts for sprouting fungi and their minds were overwritten by the cult’s ideology.
source_quote: I came here, thinking you would seek refuge amongst the Myconids. But I made the mistake of accepting Phylo’s invitation to see the Circle of Welcome.

subject: The Wedding Rehearsal

source_quote: Are you here for the wedding rehearsal?... Let the love of the Great Seeder embrace you as you become one with her chosen, the Great Body!

subject: Araumycos and Zuggtmoy

source_quote: Joined together, heart to heart, Becoming one ’til death do part! Hail! Hail! Hail! ... "There’s a wedding! I guess we arrived at the wedding!"

subject: Circle of Explorers
fact: The Circle of Explorers, led by Rasharoo, believes Myconids are naturally nomadic and that the Grove’s corruption signals impending doom. They maintain secret escape routes and reject Phylo’s sedentary reorganization, viewing it as a betrayal of Myconid essence.

subject: Circle of Growers
fact: The Circle of Growers is a Myconid subgroup led by Hepbobe, dedicated to food production and efficiency. They reject collective discourse and believe specialization enhances productivity, aligning with Phylo’s doctrine and opposing Basidia’s traditionalist views.

subject: Circle of Leaders
fact: A faction of Myconid decision-makers who now meet in isolation from the Circle of Masters, as part of Phylo’s reorganization, communicating only through targeted melds rather than collective gatherings.
source_quote: So now we have two inner circles, the circle of leaders and the circle of masters.

subject: Circle of Masters
fact: A faction of Myconid specialists and producers, including growers like Hepbobe, who operate autonomously under Phylo’s new structure, focused on task-specific productivity rather than communal consensus.
source_quote: The circle of those closest to them.

subject: Circle of Welcome
fact: The Circle of Welcome is a death cult devoted to the Great Seeder and the Great Body. Members undergo fungal transformation, sing discordant hymns, and seek to merge with the entity through death. They are responsible for infecting Drow and Myconids alike, turning them into spore servants.

subject: myconid collective
fact: The myconid collective is associated with a melodic, luminescent, decaying fungal parade that sings with gleeful insanity, and is joined in union with Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: Thorin confirms that it is similar to the music of the dancing myconid and the music we heard with Zuggtmoy.

subject: The Circle of Explorers
fact: The Circle of Explorers is a splinter faction of Myconids who reject cultivation in favor of nomadic exploration, believe the Underdark’s tunnels are a sentient entity, and view the Grove’s decay as evidence of a dying world.
source_quote: We are the few, the proud, the explorers, and the pathfinders. We are the ones who scout and see the world beyond the grove.

subject: The Circle of Welcome
fact: The Circle of Welcome is the dominant Myconid collective that practices cultivation, venerates the Great Seeder and the Great Body as divine forces, and initiates new members through fungal bonding and ritual transformation.
source_quote: The Great Seeder is here. The Lady of Decay took me.

subject: The Drow of Menzoberranzan
fact: The Drow of Menzoberranzan, under Lolth’s influence, view the fungal cult as a demonic threat; they send agents to investigate or eliminate it, and believe the Demon Queen of the Fungi now resides in the Underdark.
source_quote: You must warn the other Drow of the presence of the Demon Queen of the Fungi in the Underdark.

subject: Zuggtmoy

source_quote: Araumycos and Zuggtmoy! Joined together, heart to heart, Becoming one ’til death do part!

subject: Circle of Welcome

source_quote: The heads of dozens of underdark creatures peek from the ground. Mold and fungi grow on them, and through them. ... The Great Seeder is here. The Lady of Decay took me. ... Let the love of the Great Seeder embrace you as you become one with her chosen, the Great Body!

subject: Circle of Welcome
fact: The Circle of Welcome is the site where Xinaya and her squad were transformed by Phylo’s invitation, becoming victims of the madness.
source_quote: The female Drow coughs, 'No, to capture you. Ilvara wanted to kill you herself. I was given orders to capture you. I came here, thinking you would seek refuge amongst the Myconids. But I made the mistake of accepting Phylo’s invitation to see the Circle of Welcome. My squad and I become victims of the madness.'

subject: Garden of Welcome
fact: A grotesque field where Myconids and Drow are planted like seeds, their bodies fused with fungi. The ground pulses with spores, and corpses explode upon death. It is the ritual site of the Great Seeder’s wedding and the epicenter of the cult’s power.

subject: Garden of Welcome
fact: The Garden of Welcome contains dozens of underdark creatures with mold and fungi growing on and through them, their heads peeking from the ground.
source_quote: We approach it. And as we get closer, we hear strange mutterings. As we get closer, the mutterings turn into a cacophony of moans and hisses. The only thing in this place comes from a few glowing mushrooms, but even in the gloom. I stare in shock. The heads of dozens of underdark creatures peek from the ground. Mold and fungi grow on them, and through them.

subject: Garden of Welcome
fact: The Garden of Welcome contains planted heads that croak and groan, joining the fungal choir; it is the site of the wedding ceremony.
source_quote: The remaining heads planted in the Garden of Welcome begin to croak and groan, joining the horrible song.

subject: Garden of Welcome
fact: The Garden of Welcome is a necrotic field where Drow and other creatures are embedded in the earth and transformed by fungal growth, their voices joining a discordant chorus of wheezing song.
source_quote: The heads of dozens of underdark creatures peek from the ground. ... The remaining heads planted in the Garden of Welcome begin to croak and groan, joining the horrible song.

subject: Garden of Welcome
fact: The remaining heads planted in the Garden of Welcome croak and groan, joining the horrible song.
source_quote: The remaining heads planted in the Garden of Welcome begin to croak and groan, joining the horrible song.

subject: Giant mushroom
fact: A path leads to the giant mushroom, which is the likely locus of the Araumycos-Zuggtmoy wedding.
source_quote: Up ahead, we see a path that leads to the giant mushroom, and I think, why not?

subject: Irrigation Tunnels
fact: A network of subterranean channels maintained by Hepbobe and the Growers to sustain the colony’s fungal crops. Now partially infected by the cult’s spores, these tunnels may serve as secret pathways for escape — or invasion.

subject: Irrigation Tunnels
fact: A network of tunnels used by Hepbobe and the Circle of Masters to cultivate and distribute food for the Myconid colony, described as a source of pride and efficiency under Phylo’s new system.
source_quote: He shows the irrigation tunnels and the various kinds of fungi that are grown, 'To continuously feed and delight the Myconids that live in this community.'

subject: Misty cavern
fact: The misty cavern beyond the path emits the discordant fungal choir; it is the source of the haunting melody and fungal presence.
source_quote: Echoes spill from the misty cavern beyond, a cacophony of wheezing voices that wrap together like some kind of discordant music.

subject: Misty Cavern Beyond Giant Mushroom
fact: The misty cavern beyond the giant mushroom echoes with a cacophony of wheezing voices that wrap together like discordant music.
source_quote: Up ahead, we see a path that leads to the giant mushroom, and I think, why not? Echoes spill from the misty cavern beyond, a cacophony of wheezing voices that wrap together like some kind of discordant music.

subject: Neverlight Grove
fact: A cultivated, brightly lit area where Myconids live and grow, described as vibrant and cheery, but now the site of ideological conflict and the emergence of a dancing Myconid linked to Zuggtmoy’s melody.
source_quote: She enjoys the open air of the Neverlight Grove, with its bright, cheery light and vibrant colors.

subject: Neverlight Grove
fact: Dawnbringer enjoys the open air of the Neverlight Grove, with its bright, cheery light and vibrant colors.
source_quote: She enjoys the open air of the Neverlight Grove, with its bright, cheery light and vibrant colors.

subject: Neverlight Grove
fact: The Myconid colony’s central habitat, now corrupted by Phylo’s reorganization and the spread of the Circle of Welcome. Its fungal growths are mutating, its tunnels are shifting, and its light is becoming hostile — a sign of deeper spiritual decay.

subject: Neverlight Grove
fact: The Neverlight Grove contains bright, cheery light and vibrant colors.
source_quote: Dawnbringer has been quite chatty of late. She enjoys the open air of the Neverlight Grove, with its bright, cheery light and vibrant colors.

subject: rocky bed
fact: From rocky bed the toadstool rose.
source_quote: From rocky bed the toadstool rose

subject: The Circle of Welcome
fact: The Circle of Welcome is a sacred Myconid gathering place where new members are transformed through fungal bonding; it is the epicenter of the Great Seeder’s worship and the wedding ritual to the Great Body.
source_quote: The Great Seeder is here. The Lady of Decay took me.

subject: The Grove
fact: The Grove is a fungal ecosystem in the Underdark where Myconids cultivate and bond; it is deteriorating rapidly, changing in unpredictable and hostile ways, and is the site of the Circle of Welcome’s rituals.
source_quote: I have noticed, as has Basidia, that the Grove is not well. Every time I come back, it changes, and its changes are not for the best.

subject: The Underdark
fact: The Underdark is the subterranean realm where the fungal cult has spread, and where the Demon Queen of the Fungi now resides; it is filled with tunnels, caves, and corrupted Myconid colonies that are changing the natural order.
source_quote: There is so much more for us to explore in the Underdark. So many tunnels and caves.

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: Aberrant Myconid
fact: The aberrant myconid is a larval creature with vestigial fungal growths, possibly once a myconid.
source_quote: A disgusting larval creature rises before me. I notice some vestigial fungal growths. I wonder if this might have once been a myconid.

subject: Acid-drenching corpse
fact: A corpse explodes and releases acid, drenching the entire group.
source_quote: And then another corpse explodes, drenching us all in acid.

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: Dancing Myconid
fact: A Myconid in a state of ecstatic trance, dancing and singing a melody tied to Zuggtmoy, proclaiming Phylo’s 'great plan' and the coming of the Great Seeder, while cultivating undeveloped Myconid spores in the fields.
source_quote: 'Welcome, have you come to see the all that Myconids that will be? They are all necessary for Phylo’s great plan and the Greet Seeder who is coming!'

subject: Drow slave
fact: Two Drow have been turned into slaves; one attacks Jimjar and another is part of the spore servant network.
source_quote: Two Drow who have been turned into slaves. ... And then another one of the Drow spore servants attacks Jimjar.

subject: Drow spore servant
fact: Multiple Drow spore servants exist; they emerge from exploded heads and spread spore clouds; Sarith becomes one after his head explodes.
source_quote: Sarith’s head explodes and turns into yet another Drow spore servant. ... A spore cloud covers us all. ... And then another one of the Drow spore servants attacks Jimjar.

subject: Exploding corpse
fact: Corpses explode, curing the abomination and later drenching the group in acid.
source_quote: Just then, a corpse explodes, and the bloody parts somehow cure the abomination. ... And then another corpse explodes, drenching us all in acid.

subject: Fungal abomination
fact: A fungal abomination is present; it is killed by Zalthir after being targeted by the orc cleric of Bahamut.
source_quote: Along with this fungal abomination ... The orc cleric of Bahamut approaches the creature gingerly, invokes the power of his god, and inflicts wounds on it. ... Zalthir strikes the fungal abomination, killing it.

subject: Fungal Abomination
fact: A grotesque fusion of Myconid and Drow flesh, animated by the Great Seeder’s will. It speaks in dual voices, commands exploding corpses, and emits acid-laced spore clouds. It is the physical avatar of the wedding cult and must be destroyed to halt the spread of corruption.

subject: Fungal Abomination
fact: The fungal abomination says, 'Welcome, travelers. Are you here for the wedding rehearsal? Friends of the bride or her intended? No matter! Let the love of the Great Seeder embrace you as you become one with her chosen, the Great Body!'
source_quote: A disgusting larval creature rises before me. I notice some vestigial fungal growths. I wonder if this might have once been a myconid. 'Welcome, travelers.' The aberrant myconid’s voice gurgles and spits as it speaks both aloud and in my mind simultaneously. 'Are you here for the wedding rehearsal? Friends of the bride or her intended? No matter! Let the love of the Great Seeder embrace you as you become one with her chosen, the Great Body!'

subject: Fungal choir
fact: A cacophony of wheezing, discordant voices emerges from the misty cavern, formed by heads planted in the Garden of Welcome; it is confirmed to be similar to Zuggtmoy’s music.
source_quote: Echoes spill from the misty cavern beyond, a cacophony of wheezing voices that wrap together like some kind of discordant music. ... Thorin confirms that it is similar to the music of the dancing myconid and the music we heard with Zuggtmoy.

subject: luminescent fungal entities
fact: The luminescent fungal entities are vaguely humanoid, covered in tumescent growths and clusters of luminescent lichen, with decaying flesh and voices that stab into the mind with insane, gleeful sound.
source_quote: I see the parade of creatures responsible for the melody. Their bodies are only vaguely humanoid, with clusters of luminescent lichen and tumescent growths forming chaotic patterns on their decaying flesh, their voices stabbing into my mind, both insane and gleeful in equal parts.

subject: Myconid
fact: Two Myconids surround the group; later, Daz and Grygum kill them, and Zalthir kills the last one.
source_quote: Two Myconids now surround us. ... And watch as Daz’s bolts kill them. ... Using a guiding bolt, I wound one of the remaining Myconids. ... Zalthir kills the last of the Myconid creatures.

subject: myconid identity
fact: Myconids are a sentient species, not mere mushrooms, and they are herbivores with specific preferences and cooking styles.
source_quote: We are a special kind of mushroom, or more precisely, we are not mushrooms because we are a sentient species. Myconid’s are herbivores. Much like other creatures, we have particular preferences and cooking styles and ways of meeting, producing, and consuming the food that reflect the wide variety of tastes and pellets of the individual myconids.

subject: Spore cloud
fact: A spore cloud covers the group, emanating from Drow spore servants and contributing to the fungal contagion.
source_quote: A spore cloud covers us all.

subject: Spore Servant (Drow)
fact: Former Drow agents transformed by fungal infection into mindless, spore-emitting servants of the Great Seeder. They attack with claws and spore clouds, and their corpses explode into acid or healing spores when slain.

subject: Spore Servant (Myconid)
fact: Myconids corrupted by Phylo’s influence and the Great Seeder’s cult. They move erratically, emit toxic spores, and are driven to convert others. Their deaths trigger cascading explosions that harm allies and heal the abomination.

subject: The Aberrant Myconid Larva
fact: The Aberrant Myconid Larva is a malformed, crawling entity formed from the fusion of Myconid and fungal biomass; it retains vestigial fungal growths and speaks with both vocal and telepathic voices, serving as a herald of the Great Seeder’s wedding.
source_quote: Welcome, travelers... Let the love of the Great Seeder embrace you as you become one with her chosen, the Great Body!

subject: The Infested Myconid
fact: The Infested Myconid is a Myconid whose body has been overtaken by fungal growths and sprouts; it sings to its new sprouts and is part of the Circle of Welcome’s ritual, though its voice carries a frenetic, ecstatic energy.
source_quote: The Great Seeder is here. The Lady of Decay took me.

subject: Aliza Argot
fact: Aliza Argot is the other woman found in the caves, among the group of individuals present.
source_quote: We’re all here: Spiderbait, Jimjar, Eldeth, Sarith, Furuum, and the other woman, Aliza Argot, whom we found in the caves.

subject: Araumycos
fact: Araumycos and Zuggtmoy! Joined together, heart to heart, Becoming one ’til death do part!
source_quote: Araumycos and Zuggtmoy! Joined together, heart to heart, Becoming one ’til death do part!

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia believes the best way for Myconids to work together is through a group meld where everyone can hear from everyone.
source_quote: They say, “Phylo is changing our society. I believed that the best way for us to work together was to participate in a group meld where everyone could hear from everyone.”

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia is a Myconid circle leader who opposes Phylo’s reorganization of Myconid society, believing it will irreparably harm communal unity and that all Myconids must remain connected in a single circle to hear from everyone.
source_quote: Basidia sighed, 'Phylo said strange things like the need to eliminate cross-functional groups and instead have teams focused on the task at hand.'

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia is a Myconid elder who rejects Rasharoo’s beliefs, upholds the traditional Myconid practice of cultivation and staying in one place, and serves as a gatekeeper to the Circle of Welcome; they are skeptical of outsiders and wary of the Grove’s changes.
source_quote: No, Rasharoo is one of our kind who is always exploring... Myconids stay in one place and cultivate their gardens... I have felt that the right way for a Myconid to live is traveling, instead of sticking in one place.

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia is a Myconid leader concerned with preserving traditional Myconid communal structures and opposes Phylo’s reorganization of society into isolated circles. They view Phylo’s changes as a threat to collective identity and mental harmony.

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia releases their spores and speaks to us, saying, 'Phylo is changing our society. I believed that the best way for us to work together was to participate in a group meld where everyone could hear from everyone.'
source_quote: As we approach, Basidia releases their spores and speaks to us. They say, 'Phylo is changing our society. I believed that the best way for us to work together was to participate in a group meld where everyone could hear from everyone.'

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia says, 'Basidia is concerned that Phylo is doing something that is going to irreparably harm Myconid life.'
source_quote: Hepbobe must have overheard Basidia because he first stares at Grygum, then Basidia, and then Grygum, and then seems to sigh. 'Basidia is concerned that Phylo is doing something that is going to irreparably harm Myconid life.'

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia says, 'Hepbobe’s food supply has the evil spores, and they say no.'
source_quote: Zalthir asks Basidia whether Hebopbe’s food supply has the evil spores, and they say no.

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia says, 'I could give you a detailed analysis of our crop yields and growth, but perhaps another time.'
source_quote: I am bored, and he notices that and mutters, 'I could give you a detailed analysis of our crop yields and growth, but perhaps another time.'

subject: Basidia
fact: Basidia says, 'No, Rasharoo is one of our kind who is always exploring. That is why they are exploring. Myconids stay in one place and cultivate their gardens.'
source_quote: Basidia, if they could roll their eyes, would. 'No, Rasharoo is one of our kind who is always exploring. That is why they are exploring. Myconids stay in one place and cultivate their gardens.'

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer enjoys the open air of the Neverlight Grove, with its bright, cheery light and vibrant colors.
source_quote: Dawnbringer has been quite chatty of late. She enjoys the open air of the Neverlight Grove, with its bright, cheery light and vibrant colors.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz carries Dawnbringer, fires fire motes that explode in conflagrations, kills Myconids with bolts, and giggles after Jimjar kills Sarith.
source_quote: It’s a good thing I am carrying Dawnbringer ... the fire mote flies from Daz’s hand and explodes in a conflagration of fire. ... And watch as Daz’s bolts kill them. ... And then I distinctly notice Daz giggling.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz giggles.
source_quote: Meanwhile, Jimjar kills poor Sarith. And then I distinctly notice Daz giggling.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz says, 'If you can get out of the way.'
source_quote: Daz shouts, 'If you can get out of the way.'

subject: Eldeth
fact: Eldeth is one of the individuals present in the caves, alongside Spiderbait, Jimjar, Sarith, Furuum, and Aliza Argot.
source_quote: We’re all here: Spiderbait, Jimjar, Eldeth, Sarith, Furuum, and the other woman, Aliza Argot, whom we found in the caves.

subject: Furuum
fact: Furuum is one of the individuals present in the caves, alongside Spiderbait, Jimjar, Eldeth, Sarith, and Aliza Argot.
source_quote: We’re all here: Spiderbait, Jimjar, Eldeth, Sarith, Furuum, and the other woman, Aliza Argot, whom we found in the caves.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is a Myconid observer who sympathizes with Phylo’s reforms, comparing Myconid organizational debates to clerical debates over Bahamut’s prayers, and believes focused groups prevent distraction and inefficiency.
source_quote: Grygum nodded, 'By focusing, we can deliver better mushrooms, higher quality mushrooms, and not get distracted by the concerns of the various groups.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, 'Arranged marriages can work very well!'
source_quote: I nod, 'Arranged marriages can work very well!'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, 'Gotcha!'
source_quote: 'Exactly.' 'Gotcha!'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, 'So wait, you are mushrooms, like the food, and you eat other mushrooms?'
source_quote: Grygum awkwardly asks, 'So wait, you are mushrooms, like the food, and you eat other mushrooms?'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says, 'So you are a fungus and eat fungi, just like I am a mammal and eat animals.'
source_quote: I think I got it and ask, 'So you are a fungus and eat fungi, just like I am a mammal and eat animals.'

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum uses guiding bolt to wound Myconids, observes Xinaya crying, and is confused when Thorin kills her despite her consent.
source_quote: Using a guiding bolt, I wound one of the remaining Myconids. ... I look at Xinaya and notice that she is crying. ... I am confused.

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe believes organizational structures are meaningless to those who have a job to do maintaining the farming supply.
source_quote: Those of us who have a job to do to maintain the farming supply do not think that this is meaningful one way or another.

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe is a Myconid grower and ally of Phylo who believes organizational structures are irrelevant to those who perform practical labor, and that focusing on specific tasks improves productivity and quality of food production.
source_quote: Hepbobe said, 'Those of us who have a job to do to maintain the farming supply do not think that this is meaningful one way or another.'

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe is a Myconid grower and loyal follower of Phylo, focused solely on food production and efficiency. They dismiss organizational debates as irrelevant to their work and believe specialization increases productivity, even if it fragments communal unity.

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe is a sentient Myconid who insists they are not mushrooms but a special kind of sentient species.
source_quote: It’s a typical misconception of softers who think all mushrooms are just that, mushrooms. We are a special kind of mushroom, or more precisely, we are not mushrooms because we are a sentient species.

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe says, 'I, on the other hand, believe that these organizational constructs, whether it's one or many, are things that only Sovereigns care about. Those of us who have a job to do to maintain the farming supply do not think that this is meaningful one way or another.'
source_quote: Hepbobe must have overheard Basidia because he first stares at Grygum, then Basidia, and then Grygum, and then seems to sigh. 'I, on the other hand, believe that these organizational constructs, whether it's one or many, are things that only Sovereigns care about. Those of us who have a job to do to maintain the farming supply do not think that this is meaningful one way or another.'

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe says, 'Myconid’s are herbivores. Much like other creatures, we have particular preferences and cooking styles and ways of meeting, producing, and consuming the food that reflect the wide variety of tastes and pellets of the individual myconids.'
source_quote: Hepbobe sensing someone who wishes to learn continues, as if he were explaining something to a small child. 'Myconid’s are herbivores. Much like other creatures, we have particular preferences and cooking styles and ways of meeting, producing, and consuming the food that reflect the wide variety of tastes and pellets of the individual myconids.'

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe says, 'We are a special kind of mushroom, or more precisely, we are not mushrooms because we are a sentient species.'
source_quote: Hepbobe acts as if they have seen this before, 'It’s a typical misconception of softers who think all mushrooms are just that, mushrooms. We are a special kind of mushroom, or more precisely, we are not mushrooms because we are a sentient species.'

subject: Hepbobe
fact: Hepbobe says, 'We are in charge of growing food for the colony.'
source_quote: As we approach, Hepbobe starts talking to us once the Spores of Raport connect with our mind. 'We are in charge of growing food for the colony.'

subject: Her joyous spores
fact: Her joyous spores will spread!
source_quote: Her joyous spores will spread!

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is a Myconid who has not been infected by harmful spores but has become emotionally resigned to Phylo’s changes, accepting the 'wedding' as joyous and no longer making bets — a sign of psychological surrender to the cult’s influence.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is a Myconid who has not made a bet in some time and appears to have overheard conversations about the wedding; they are unaffected by infection but display unusual awareness of the Myconid rituals.
source_quote: I don’t see the point in making a bet. Everyone is so happy about this wedding.

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar is covered in spores and stops moving; later, he kills Sarith and mutters about not knowing if they are guests or the feast.
source_quote: I see to my left Jimjar covered in spores, and then he stops moving. ... Meanwhile, Jimjar kills poor Sarith. ... Jimjar mutters, "I don't know."

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar mutters that he doesn't know.
source_quote: Jimjar mutters, "I don't know."

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar mutters, 'I don’t know.'
source_quote: Jimjar mutters, 'I don’t know.'

subject: Jimjar
fact: Jimjar says, 'I don’t see the point in making a bet. Everyone is so happy about this wedding.'
source_quote: Jimjar must have overheard me, 'I don’t see the point in making a bet. Everyone is so happy about this wedding.'

subject: Phylo
fact: Phylo is a Myconid circle leader advocating for decentralized governance, where each group of Myconids holds internal melds and only leaders communicate across groups, claiming this structure is endorsed by the Great Seeder and leads to greater efficiency.
source_quote: Phylo convinced some of the circle leaders that the Great Seeder told them of another way.

subject: Phylo
fact: Phylo is a radical Myconid reformer who seeks to restructure Myconid society by replacing the Great Circle with nested, task-specific melds. They claim the Great Seeder instructed them to abandon collective discourse in favor of focused, hierarchical coordination — a doctrine that divides the colony.

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo believes the caves and tunnels are another Myconid that connects everything, and Myconids are messages for it.
source_quote: I think the caves and tunnels are really another Myconid that connects everything. And that we are messages for that myconid.

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo believes the natural state of a Myconid is nomadic, not sedentary cultivation.
source_quote: The myconid is a nomad.

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo is a Myconid Explorer who believes the natural state of Myconids is nomadic, not sedentary. They distrust Phylo’s changes and fear the Grove’s decay, maintaining escape routes and nutrient caches in preparation for possible flight from the corrupted colony.

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo is a Myconid explorer who believes the natural state of Myconids is nomadic, that the Grove is deteriorating, and that the tunnels are a living entity connected to all Myconids; they distrust the Overbrite and seek escape routes.
source_quote: We are the few, the proud, the explorers, and the pathfinders... I have noticed, as has Basidia, that the Grove is not well... I think the caves and tunnels are really another Myconid that connects everything.

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo says, 'I have felt that the right way for a Myconid to live is traveling, instead of sticking in one place. The myconid is a nomad.'
source_quote: Rasharoo says, 'I have felt that the right way for a Myconid to live is traveling, instead of sticking in one place. The myconid is a nomad.'

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo says, 'That would be a terrible idea. Myconids thrive in the dark. Why would we go into the light of the Overbrite? There is so much more for us to explore in the Underdark. So many tunnels and caves. I think the caves and tunnels are really another Myconid that connects everything. And that we are messages for that myconid.'
source_quote: Rasharoo is disgusted, 'That would be a terrible idea. Myconids thrive in the dark. Why would we go into the light of the Overbrite? There is so much more for us to explore in the Underdark. So many tunnels and caves. I think the caves and tunnels are really another Myconid that connects everything. And that we are messages for that myconid.'

subject: Rasharoo
fact: Rasharoo says, 'We are the few, the proud, the explorers, and the pathfinders. We are the ones who scout and see the world beyond the grove.'
source_quote: The Myconid enters Basidia’s cloud of spores and starts talking. 'We are the few, the proud, the explorers, and the pathfinders. We are the ones who scout and see the world beyond the grove.'

subject: Sarith
fact: Sarith’s head explodes and turns into a Drow spore servant; later, Jimjar kills him.
source_quote: And to my horror, Sarith’s head explodes and turns into yet another Drow spore servant. ... Meanwhile, Jimjar kills poor Sarith.

subject: Spiderbait
fact: Spiderbait is one of the individuals present in the caves, alongside Jimjar, Eldeth, Sarith, Furuum, and Aliza Argot.
source_quote: We’re all here: Spiderbait, Jimjar, Eldeth, Sarith, Furuum, and the other woman, Aliza Argot, whom we found in the caves.

subject: The Aberrant Myconid
fact: The Aberrant Myconid is a twisted, larval entity born from corrupted Myconid flesh, speaking in dual voices and promoting the worship of the Great Seeder and the Great Body as a divine wedding; it welcomes travelers to the ritual.
source_quote: Welcome, travelers... Are you here for the wedding rehearsal?... Let the love of the Great Seeder embrace you as you become one with her chosen, the Great Body!

subject: The Fungal Abomination
fact: A corrupted hybrid of Myconid and Drow, transformed by the Great Seeder’s influence. It speaks in dual voices, invites travelers to join the 'wedding,' and uses exploding corpses and acid spores as weapons, serving as the physical manifestation of the cult’s grotesque theology.

subject: The Lady
fact: The Lady will be wed!
source_quote: The Lady will be wed!

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks whether the party are guests or the feast.
source_quote: Thorin asks, "Are we guests or the feast?"

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asks, 'Are we guests or the feast?'
source_quote: Thorin asks, 'Are we guests or the feast?'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin confirms that the melody is similar to the music of the dancing myconid and the music we heard with Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: Thorin confirms that it is similar to the music of the dancing myconid and the music we heard with Zuggtmoy

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a Drow who abhors the dark and fungal abominations, and prefers to end suffering quickly, even if it means killing an infected ally; he is emotionally overwhelmed by the corruption around him.
source_quote: Dawnbringer really doesn’t like the dark. And I really don’t like fungal growths that can turn you into abominations.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is a Myconid who recognizes the same chaotic melody from Zuggtmoy’s dream in the dancing Myconid’s song, linking Phylo’s movement to ancient, malevolent forces and sensing an underlying corruption.
source_quote: Thorin does, it’s the same melody that we heard when we saw Zuggtmoy in his dream. It has no rhythm, no beauty, it revels in a symphony of chaos and evil. It hurts.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'Boom.'
source_quote: I know what is coming next. 'Boom.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'Enough?'
source_quote: I shrug. 'How many do you think there are?' he adds. 'Enough?' I answer.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'I am carrying Dawnbringer, because the sunlight hurts these creatures.'
source_quote: It’s a good thing I am carrying Dawnbringer, because the sunlight hurts these creatures.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'I asked, and she said okay. We’re an arranged marriage.'
source_quote: Thorin laughs, 'I asked, and she said okay. We’re an arranged marriage.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'I can hear the music.'
source_quote: Thorin stops and tells us, 'I can hear the music.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'I really don’t like fungal growths that can turn you into abominations.'
source_quote: Dawnbringer really doesn’t like the dark. And I really don’t like fungal growths that can turn you into abominations.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'I think to myself that I dodged a bullet there with Z.'
source_quote: I think to myself that I dodged a bullet there with Z.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin says, 'This is a death cult.'
source_quote: Thorin turns to me, 'This is a death cult.'

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin talks to Dawnbringer about kindness, kills Xinaya after she consents, and confirms the music is similar to Zuggtmoy’s; he jokes about arranged marriage.
source_quote: Thorin marches up to her, talks to Dawnbringer about the kindness of the gesture, Dawnbringer agrees, and Xinaya is killed. ... Thorin confirms that it is similar to the music of the dancing myconid and the music we heard with Zuggtmoy. ... "I asked, and she said okay. We’re an arranged marriage."

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya is crying near liberation, consents to death when asked by Thorin, and is killed despite being alive.
source_quote: I look at Xinaya and notice that she is crying. ... Thorin asks, and she said okay. ... She is still alive. I am confused. ... Xinaya is killed.

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya says, 'I was given orders to capture you.'
source_quote: The female Drow coughs, 'No, to capture you. Ilvara wanted to kill you herself. I was given orders to capture you.'

source_quote: The thing that was once a drow laughs. 'My name is Xinaya, and I was sent to find you. Ilvara thought you would come here.'

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya says, 'Please, for the love of your gods of light, kill me.'
source_quote: She is fighting to speak, 'Please, for the love of your gods of light, kill me.'

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya says, 'The Great Seeder is here. The Lady of Decay took me.'
source_quote: She moans, 'The Great Seeder is here. The Lady of Decay took me.'

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya says, 'Who would have thought that I would be begging you to kill me?'
source_quote: She cackles, 'Who would have thought that I would be begging you to kill me?'

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya says, 'You are from Menzoberranzan. You must warn the other Drow of the presence of the Demon Queen of the Fungi in the Underdark.'
source_quote: And then she notices me, perhaps for the first time, and takes the haughty tone of a female Drow follower of Lolth towards any male, 'You are from Menzoberranzan. You must warn the other Drow of the presence of the Demon Queen of the Fungi in the Underdark.'

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya was a Drow agent sent by Ilvara to capture the party but was infected by Phylo’s spores and transformed into a fungal slave. She now begs for death, having been consumed by the cult of the Great Seeder and the Lady of Decay.

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya was a Drow agent sent by Ilvara to capture the travelers, but became infected after accepting Phylo’s invitation to the Circle of Welcome; her body is now a host for fungal growths and she begs to be killed.
source_quote: My name is Xinaya, and I was sent to find you. Ilvara thought you would come here... I was given orders to capture you... My squad and I become victims of the madness.

subject: Xinaya
fact: Xinaya was sent by Ilvara to capture the party but was corrupted after accepting Phylo’s invitation to the Circle of Welcome.
source_quote: I was given orders to capture you. I came here, thinking you would seek refuge amongst the Myconids. But I made the mistake of accepting Phylo’s invitation to see the Circle of Welcome.

subject: Yrberop
fact: Yrberop declares, 'Welcome, have you come to see the all that Myconids that will be? They are all necessary for Phylo’s great plan and the Greet Seeder who is coming!'
source_quote: The creature, in a sing-songy voice, as if it is in some kind of ecstasy, and then declares, 'Welcome, have you come to see the all that Myconids that will be? They are all necessary for Phylo’s great plan and the Greet Seeder who is coming!'

subject: Yrberop
fact: Yrberop is a Myconid in ecstatic trance, singing of the 'Great Seeder’s wedding' to the 'Great Body' and the coming of the Overbright. Their song echoes the same melody heard during Zuggtmoy’s dream, indicating deep corruption and possible possession by an elder evil.

subject: Yrberop
fact: Yrberop sings about 'the Great Seeder, and her 'wedding' to the Great Body and how every Myconid is invited bringing joy to all in the world below and above.'
source_quote: Thorin stops and tells us, 'I can hear the music.' And we worry, 'No the lyrics. Yrberop, that’s the Myconid’s name, is singing about some Great Seeder, and her “wedding” to the Great Body and how every Myconid is invited bringing joy to all in the world below and above.'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a Drow who exhibits traditional Drow instincts—curiosity over violence, questioning over killing—and seeks to understand the nature of the fungal infection and the Myconid cult, contrasting with Thorin’s desire to end suffering.
source_quote: How do we avoid your fate?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a perceptive Myconid who recognizes the deeper implications of Phylo’s changes and questions the nature of Myconid identity, connection, and the potential corruption of their traditions.
source_quote: Zalthir asked Basidia whether Hepbobe’s food supply has the evil spores, and they say no.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir kills the fungal abomination and the last Myconid, questions Xinaya’s death, and asks about the number of exploding corpses.
source_quote: Zalthir strikes the fungal abomination, killing it. ... Zalthir kills the last of the Myconid creatures. ... "Exploding corpses?" shouts Zalthir. ... "Is she okay with it?"

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'Exploding corpses?'
source_quote: Zalthir shouts, 'Exploding corpses?'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'Gotcha!'
source_quote: 'Exactly.' 'Gotcha!'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'How many do you think there are?'
source_quote: 'How many do you think there are?' he adds.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'I am confused.'
source_quote: I am confused.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'I ask Basidia if he has been infected and they say no.'
source_quote: I ask Basidia if he has been infected and they say no.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'I can hear the music.'
source_quote: Thorin stops and tells us, 'I can hear the music.'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'I don’t see the point in making a bet.'
source_quote: Jimjar must have overheard me, 'I don’t see the point in making a bet.'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'I think I got it.'
source_quote: I think I got it and ask, 'So you are a fungus and eat fungi, just like I am a mammal and eat animals.'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'I will not become a zombie.'
source_quote: I will not have my mind infected by these things. I will not become a zombie…

source_quote: Zalthir looks confused, 'Is she okay with it?'

source_quote: Thorin turns to me, 'This is a death cult.'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'We are an arranged marriage.'
source_quote: Thorin laughs, 'I asked, and she said okay. We’re an arranged marriage.'

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir says, 'Why he must have known about this wedding.'
source_quote: And I wonder why he must have known about this wedding.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a weapon carried by Daz; it responds to Thorin’s inquiries and is associated with sunlight that harms fungal creatures.
source_quote: It’s a good thing I am carrying Dawnbringer ... Thorin talks to Dawnbringer about the kindness of the gesture, Dawnbringer agrees ...

subject: Evil Spores
fact: A dangerous fungal contaminant feared by Zalthir, which Basidia confirms is absent from Hepbobe’s food supply, suggesting the corruption lies not in the food but in the ideology and the melody of the dancing Myconid.
source_quote: Zalthir asked Basidia whether Hepbobe’s food supply has the evil spores, and they say no.

subject: irrigation tunnels
fact: The irrigation tunnels and various kinds of fungi are grown to continuously feed and delight the Myconids that live in this community.
source_quote: He shows the irrigation tunnels and the various kinds of fungi that are grown, “To continuously feed and delight the Myconids that live in this community.”

subject: Nutrient Caches
fact: Hidden reserves of sustenance maintained by Rasharoo and the Explorers. These caches may contain the only viable food sources left in the corrupted Grove — and could be key to survival if the colony collapses.

subject: Nutrient Caches
fact: Nutrient caches are hidden reserves of sustenance maintained by Myconid explorers like Rasharoo; they are intended for survival during flight from the deteriorating Grove or fungal incursions.
source_quote: I have a few escape routes and nutrient caches should we ever need to flee.

subject: Secret Passageway to the Circle of Welcome
fact: A hidden passageway leads into the Circle of Welcome, known only to select Myconids like Rasharoo; it allows entry without ritual initiation and may be used for escape or infiltration.
source_quote: If you wish, I could send you into the Circle of Welcome through a secret passageway.

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Spider Medallion
fact: A Drow artifact fused with fungal growths on Xinaya’s arm. Once a symbol of Lolth’s favor, it is now a corrupted relic, indicating the convergence of Drow religious iconography and the Great Seeder’s influence.

subject: Spider Medallion of Xinaya
fact: Xinaya’s spider medallion, once a symbol of Lolth’s favor, has been fused with her flesh by fungal growths, becoming a biological artifact of her transformation and loss of identity.
source_quote: She raises what I think is a hand, and it is a spider medallion covered in fungi that have fused the medallion with her body.

subject: spore-infested Drow medallion
fact: Xinaya’s spider medallion has fused with her body through fungal growth, marking her as a transformed servant of the Great Seeder.
source_quote: She raises what I think is a hand, and it is a spider medallion covered in fungi that have fused the medallion with her body.

subject: The Great Seeder’s Song
fact: A discordant, rhythmless melody heard in the Garden of Welcome and during Zuggtmoy’s dream. It has no beauty, only chaos and pain. Those who hear it report visions of fungal weddings and the merging of minds — suggesting it is a psychic weapon or divine hymn.

subject: Zuggtmoy’s Melody
fact: A dissonant, chaotic, and painful musical pattern heard by Thorin in the dancing Myconid’s song, identical to the melody from Zuggtmoy’s dream, indicating a direct spiritual or psychic link between Phylo’s movement and the ancient fungal god.
source_quote: It’s the same melody that we heard when we saw Zuggtmoy in his dream. It has no rhythm, no beauty, it revels in a symphony of chaos and evil. It hurts.

subject: Guests or feast?
fact: The group is unsure whether they are attendees of the fungal wedding or its consumable offerings; Jimjar voices the ambiguity.
source_quote: Thorin asks, "Are we guests or the feast?" ... Jimjar mutters, "I don't know."

subject: How many exploding corpses?
fact: The group is uncertain how many corpses are capable of exploding; Zalthir asks, and the answer implies more are coming.
source_quote: "How many do you think there are?" he adds. ... "Enough?" I answer.

subject: identity of the feast
fact: It is unresolved whether the party are guests or the feast at the fungal wedding.
source_quote: Thorin asks, "Are we guests or the feast?"

subject: Jimjar’s silence on betting
fact: Jimjar has not made a bet in some time and seems to know about the wedding, but his awareness and motives are unexplained.
source_quote: I don’t see the point in making a bet. Everyone is so happy about this wedding.

subject: Jimjar's uncertainty
fact: Jimjar's lack of knowledge suggests an unresolved tension about the nature of the event and the party's role in it.
source_quote: Jimjar mutters, "I don't know."

subject: The Demon Queen of the Fungi
fact: The Demon Queen of the Fungi is believed to have crossed into the Prime Material Plane and the Underdark, manifesting through the Myconid cult and the corruption of the Grove; Drow and Myconids alike fear her ascension.
source_quote: The Demon Queen and Demogorgon are here, in the Prime Material Plane and in the Underdark.

subject: The Great Seeder
fact: A prophesied entity referenced by Phylo and the dancing Myconid as the source of the new organizational doctrine, potentially a corrupted or false manifestation of the Myconid ancestral spirit, possibly linked to Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: '...the Greet Seeder who is coming!'

subject: The Great Seeder
fact: An ancient, possibly divine entity worshipped by the Circle of Welcome. Believed to be the source of the wedding ritual and the transformation of Myconids and Drow into fungal hybrids. Its true nature is unknown, but its song echoes Zuggtmoy’s presence.

subject: The Lady of Decay
fact: A title claimed by Xinaya as the force that transformed her. Likely an avatar or aspect of the Great Seeder, or perhaps a separate entity — possibly linked to Zuggtmoy — that consumes and reshapes life into fungal abominations.

subject: The Nature of Myconid Identity
fact: A schism exists among Myconids over whether their natural state is cultivation or nomadic exploration; this ideological conflict may determine the future of the Grove and the fate of the Circle of Welcome.
source_quote: I think the caves and tunnels are really another Myconid that connects everything. And that we are messages for that myconid.

subject: The Overbright
fact: A mysterious destination mentioned by the dancing Myconid, where Myconids are to be sent to 'share our stories,' potentially a euphemism for a ritualistic or destructive transformation under Phylo’s plan.
source_quote: 'Have you heard of Gasbide’s plan to send us to the Overbright to share our stories?'

subject: The Overbright
fact: A mysterious, light-filled realm referenced by Yrberop and Xinaya as the destination for the 'wedding.' It is presented as a paradise by the cult, but its light is toxic to Myconids — suggesting it may be a trap, a lie, or the domain of a greater evil.

subject: The Overbrite
fact: The Overbrite is a feared celestial light source in the Underdark; Myconids believe it is unnatural and destructive, and the idea of visiting it is considered heretical and suicidal.
source_quote: That would be a terrible idea. Myconids thrive in the dark. Why would we go into the light of the Overbrite?

subject: the wedding
fact: There is a wedding, but the nature of the participants' role in it is unspecified.
source_quote: There’s a wedding! I guess we arrived at the wedding!

subject: Xinaya’s consent
fact: Xinaya’s consent to death is confirmed by Thorin, but her survival and subsequent killing create moral and narrative ambiguity.
source_quote: She is still alive. I am confused. ... "I asked, and she said okay."

subject: Yrberop’s song
fact: The melody Yrberop sings is identical to the one heard when seeing Zuggtmoy in a dream, but its meaning is unverified.
source_quote: It’s the same melody that we heard when we saw Zuggtmoy in his dream. It has no rhythm, no beauty, it revels in a symphony of chaos and evil. It hurts.
